blurb: Guests can rent canoes and kayaks to paddle the AuSable River, with shuttle services available to transport vehicles and watercraft. The business also offers a bed & breakfast with river views and comfortable rooms. Camping and canoeing trips with recommended itineraries and packing advice are provided.
